messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from the side. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from the side. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands still, then bends forward and brings his hands up toward his face before straightening back up.","camera":"Static medium shot at eye level, framing the character from the thighs up in profile.","clothing":"A light plaid long-sleeve shirt with rolled sleeves, brown leather suspenders, and dark trousers with a belt.","hair_color":"White or very light gray.","hairstyle":"Short hair with a small topknot bun at the back of the head.","identity":"A Black man with a slim build, shown in profile and three-quarter views.","scene":"A cobblestone street in front of a dark storefront with red curtains and gold lettering advertising soap, cocoa powder, and other goods."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is now a static side/medium shot framing the character from roughly the thighs up, matching the reference's profile direction and storefront background. The character's white hair, plaid shirt, suspenders, dark trousers, and forward-bending hand-to-face action are retained with similar timing.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to an upper-body side shot matching the reference's viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the framing is strictly upper-body or a medium shot from the thighs up.
unexpected_changes: The environment changed from the original open cobblestone street with Union Jack flag and distant buildings to a dark storefront with red curtains and gold lettering, although this matches the provided reference.
